description: REQ-W1 requires that AT the end of EVERY proactive-loop tick (= after STEP 7 build_log append, before dispatcher exit) THE DISPATCHER SHALL append ONE line to <slot_dir>/roi.jsonl. The dispatcher has TWO early-return paths that reach the STEP-7 build_log append but skip the ROI append entirely: (a) the skip guard at lines 132-139 (skip reasons: 'dormant-sentinel', 'unfixable-cascade', 'minimal-budget-no-tasks') calls append_pass and returns 0 without ever calling append_roi_row; (b) the step5-no-unblocked path at lines 153-166 (picked is None → EDGE-S4 sink) calls append_pass and returns 0 without ever calling append_roi_row. EDGE-E5 (spec §4) explicitly states 'pass had no picked (= STEP 5 returned None) → roi_jpy_expected = 0, picked = null, outcome copied verbatim' — this REQUIRES a row to be written on the picked=None path. As shipped, roi.jsonl only gains a row on the fully-happy path (budget != MINIMAL AND picked != None AND dormant sentinel absent AND unfixable_count < 3). Under any skip or no-unblocked outcome the ROI signal is silently dropped, defeating the per-pass tracking premise of the sprint. The live E2E only exercised the happy path so this gap was not caught by the smoke test. Fix: hoist the roi_row + append_roi_row block into a finally-style tail or emit an equivalent skip/no-pick row before every early return.

evidence.snippet:
if skip:
    _write_status(slot_dir, slot=slot, status="idle", step=f"skip-{reason}")
    append_pass(...)
    return 0
...
if picked is None:
    write_unfixable_cascade_sink(...)
    _write_status(slot_dir, slot=slot, status="idle", step="step5-no-unblocked")
    append_pass(...)
    return 0
...
# STEP 7.5 (sprint-3 #34): append roi.jsonl row.  <-- ONLY REACHED ON HAPPY PATH
